## Findings

### Anti-patterns

- God function: <module> in docs/site/chapters.js calls 527 unique functions — consider decomposing into smaller, focused functions [critical]
- cli/check/*.ts (beginnings, brand, city, context, fields, intelligence, policy, relations, migrations, routes, settings, modules, lenses) each import directly from internal submodules — schema/schema.ts, mutations/{derive-edits,node-ref,decidable}.ts, permissions/policy.ts, theme/{derive,kit,types}.ts, city.ts, beginning.ts, schema/{figures,define-node}.ts — by relative path rather than through a single check-facing seam or core's own index.ts barrel. The checker suite therefore has no boundary from core internals: renaming or moving any of those ~9 internal modules ripples across every check/*.ts file individually, and the 'core-cli → core: 15 imports' crossing is really many independent point-to-point reaches rather than one interface. [warning] (core)

### Patterns

- Consumers of core-ops (store.ts, persistence/{sqlite,memory,types}.ts, permissions/types.ts, sync/types.ts) sit strictly downstream — no file inside ops/ imports any of them back — so despite the high raw coupling number the dependency shape is a clean, acyclic layer rather than a leak. [info] (core-ops)

### Relationships

- Tightly coupled modules: packages/studio/src/changes.ts and packages/studio/src/source.ts — 33 cross-file calls (unidirectional). Consider extracting shared interface or merging [info]

### Observations

- High cohesion (1) — files are tightly interconnected [info] (apps)

- High cohesion (1) — files are tightly interconnected [info] (apps-rota)

- High cohesion (1) — files are tightly interconnected [info] (apps-spike)

- Zones "Core" and "Core Cli" may be one architectural concept; the import graph links them but the judgment was undecided. [info] (core)
- High coupling (0.77) — 15 imports target "core" [warning] (core-cli)
- ... and 43 more

### Suggestions

- Zone "apps" has files across 11 directories — consider consolidating under a dedicated directory [info] (apps)
- Zone "core" has files across 14 directories — consider consolidating under a dedicated directory [info] (core)
- packages/core/src/cli/check/ contains files from 4 zones (core, core-cli, core-mutations, core-schema) — consider grouping into subdirectories to clarify architectural boundaries [info]
- Hub function: launchEngine in scripts/lib/engine.mjs is called from 22 files (high fan-in expected for this module type) — changes here have wide impact, consider if responsibilities can be narrowed [info]
- Hub function: useGraview in packages/react/src/context.tsx is called from 10 files — changes here have wide impact, consider if responsibilities can be narrowed [info]
- 5 potentially unused exports in packages/pages/src/page-places.tsx have no incoming calls: PlacePicture, GalleryCard, PlaceCard, DefaultPlacesPage, DefaultPlacePage [warning]
- 3 potentially unused exports in packages/core/src/cli/check/relations.ts have no incoming calls: checkReadings, checkActsFromEnds, checkUnmakeable [info]
